# odinex_server_type (Data Source)

Looks up a server type by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_server_type" "s2" {
  name = "s2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the server type.
- `name` (String) Name of the server type.

### Read-Only

- `cores` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `cpu_type` (String) `shared` or `dedicated`.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether the type is deprecated.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `disk` (Number) Disk in GB.
- `included_traffic` (Number) Included traffic in bytes per month.
- `memory` (Number) Memory in GB.
- `prices` (List of Object) Prices per location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Read-Only:

- `location` (String)
- `price_hourly_gross` (String)
- `price_hourly_net` (String)
- `price_monthly_gross` (String)
- `price_monthly_net` (String)
